{{Quote|It was the Bane Brigade and its Sith commanders who purged the Jedi Enclave on Genarius and set fire to the seas of Iskalon.|Khun Tazith|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Empire's [[Bane Brigade]] '''attacked''' the ocean [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]]. Under the command of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], the Brigade set fire to the oceans, leading the Republic to label them butchers and war criminals.
